events.title: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume work
events.title_zh: Anthropic 发布面向高吞吐任务的 Claude Haiku 5.5
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 across its API, apps, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. The model has a 1M-token context window and targets summaries, compaction, classification, customer support, browser use and coding subagents. Standard pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens up to 100K prompt tokens, with five-times rates above that threshold.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 API、应用、AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5。模型提供 100 万 token 上下文，面向摘要、压缩、分类、客服、浏览器操作与编码 subagent。提示不超过 10 万 token 时，标准价为每百万输入 0.10 美元、输出 0.50 美元；超过阈值后价格为五倍。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams routing high-volume agent work, Haiku 5.5 sharply lowers the cost floor while keeping long context and broad cloud availability. The 100K price cliff and vendor-only quality claims make workload-specific evaluation essential.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对路由高吞吐 agent 任务的团队来说，Haiku 5.5 在保留长上下文和多云可用性的同时大幅降低成本底线。10 万 token 价格跳档和厂商单方质量主张要求团队按真实负载验证。

events.title: Liquid AI releases multimodal d1 decision models for edge devices
events.title_zh: Liquid AI 发布面向边缘设备的多模态 d1 决策模型
events.summary_en: Liquid AI released d1-3B and experimental d1-omni-600M weights for single-pass typed decisions instead of token generation. d1-3B accepts text and images; d1-omni adds text-image or text-audio inputs. Liquid reports 8 ms per decision on an RTX 4090 and 50 ms on Jetson Orin Nano for d1-3B, with public demos and code loaded through trust_remote_code.
events.summary_zh: Liquid AI 发布 d1-3B 与实验性的 d1-omni-600M 权重。它们不生成文本，而是一次前向计算返回带类型的决策。d1-3B 支持文本与图像；d1-omni 支持文本加图像或文本加音频。Liquid 报告 d1-3B 在 RTX 4090 上单次决策为 8 毫秒，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上为 50 毫秒，并开放 demo 与代码。
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, moderation and edge inspection, a compact model can move structured decisions off the generative path and reduce latency. The benchmarks are vendor-run, the custom LFM license needs review and trust_remote_code expands the execution boundary.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对路由、审核与边缘检测来说，小模型可以把结构化决策移出生成链路并降低延迟。benchmark 由厂商运行，自定义 LFM 许可需要审查，trust_remote_code 也扩大了执行边界。

events.title: ExpDis separates exploration from optimization in RLVR
events.title_zh: ExpDis 将 RLVR 的探索与优化拆开
events.summary: Exploration-Distillation trains novelty-seeking explorer policies, filters their correct trajectories and distills them into a separate student that optimizes without the novelty bonus. The authors report gains over DAPO at the same wall-clock budget across seven math benchmarks and two model families, with more diverse correct solutions.
events.summary_zh: Exploration-Distillation 先训练追求新颖解法的 explorer，再筛出正确轨迹，蒸馏给不带新颖性奖励的独立 student。作者报告：在相同 wall-clock 预算下，ExpDis 在七个数学 benchmark、两个模型家族上优于 DAPO，并生成更多样的正确解法。
events.why_it_matters: For teams training reasoning models, the method offers a way to scale exploration without letting sparse verifiable rewards damage the production policy. The public code and checkpoints make a small independent replication possible, but the reported gains remain author evidence.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对训练推理模型的团队来说，这种拆分可以扩大探索，同时避免稀疏的可验证奖励损伤最终策略。代码与 checkpoint 已公开，能做小规模独立复现，但目前性能提升仍来自作者报告。

events.title: SciExam tests whether agents can build climate models without known answers
events.title_zh: SciExam 检验 agent 能否在未知答案下构建气候模型
events.summary: SciExam for ENSO gives agents six hours to build low-order climate models from real observations without a known target answer. Hidden graders test statistics, reconstruction of unobserved variables and forecasts on held-out years. Six of twelve tested agent systems reportedly beat the published-model baseline, and the authors release the benchmark and grading code.
events.summary_zh: SciExam for ENSO 给 agent 六小时，让它们基于真实观测构建低阶气候模型，而不是追一个已知答案。隐藏 grader 检查统计特征、未观测变量重建与留出年份预测。十二套 agent 中有六套据作者报告超过已发表模型 baseline；benchmark 与评分代码已经公开。
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating research agents, SciExam measures whether an agent can produce a model that survives unseen scientific tests, not merely match a rubric. The public package supports regrading, but claims about scientific usefulness still need domain-expert and independent replication.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估科研 agent 的团队来说，SciExam 检查的是模型能否通过未见过的科学测试，而不只是贴合 rubric。公开包支持重新评分，但科学价值仍需领域专家与独立复现确认。

events.title: RunningTab keeps workspace-agent obligations outside the context window
events.title_zh: RunningTab 在上下文窗口外追踪 agent 的交付义务
events.summary: RunningTab adds an environment-side record to direct workspace interaction. It tracks task requirements, excerpts with provenance and listed-but-unopened files, then blocks finishing while obligations remain unresolved. The authors report consistent gains over plain workspace interaction and model-maintained records across three benchmarks and three LLMs.
events.summary_zh: RunningTab 为直接 workspace 交互增加环境侧记录。它追踪任务要求、带来源的摘录，以及已列出但未打开的文件，并在义务未解决时阻止结束。作者报告：在三个 benchmark、三个 LLM 上，它持续优于普通 workspace 交互和由模型自己维护的记录。
events.why_it_matters: For teams building long-running file agents, this suggests that completeness state belongs in the runtime, not only in model context. Without public code or a harness, the design is actionable as an architecture signal but not yet ready for a team POC.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建长时程文件 agent 的团队来说，这说明完成度状态应由 runtime 保存，而不能只留在模型上下文里。由于没有公开代码或 harness，目前更适合作为架构信号，还不值得安排团队 POC。

events.title: Docker Agent packages multi-agent workflows as OCI artifacts
events.title_zh: Docker Agent 将多 agent 工作流打包为 OCI 产物
events.summary: Docker Agent is an Apache-2.0 CLI plugin and runtime for declarative YAML agents, multi-agent delegation, MCP tools, RAG and OCI distribution. Version 1.149.0 adds GitHub-hosted skill loading, a dedicated evaluator backend, OpenAI Decisions evaluation and complete debug-tool hook coverage. The repository had about 4,162 stars at review time.

events.title: Microsoft rebuilds Agent Lightning around real agent harnesses
events.title_zh: Microsoft 重构 Agent Lightning，让真实 harness 直接参与 RL
events.summary_zh: Microsoft Research 开源重构后的 Agent Lightning v1.0。它通过 OpenAI 兼容代理观察现有 agent harness 的模型调用，不要求把执行循环重写进训练框架。约 3,500 行控制面支持本地进程与 Kubernetes rollout；作者报告用约 6,000 个样本把 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 的 Pass@1 从 41.8% 提升到 56.4%。
events.summary_en: Microsoft Research open-sourced a rebuilt Agent Lightning v1.0. An OpenAI-compatible proxy observes model calls from an existing agent harness, avoiding a rewrite of its execution loop inside the training framework. The roughly 3,500-line control plane runs local or Kubernetes rollouts; the authors report that about 6,000 samples raised Qwen3.5-9B from 41.8% to 56.4% Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对训练真实 coding agent 的团队来说，部署用的 harness 可直接进入 RL，减少训练与线上行为不一致。结果仍是作者报告，且训练会记录 prompt、response 与 log probability；试用前要验证隔离、脱敏、失败恢复和成本。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams training real coding agents, the deployed harness can participate directly in RL, reducing divergence between training and production behavior. Results remain author-reported, and the system records prompts, responses and log probabilities; validate isolation, redaction, recovery and cost before adoption.
